about: Shot list for 跨越中等收入陷阱 (docs/middle-income-trap/video-plan.md), zh-edit v0.5. `at` is where a shot starts: a line id (its start), `id@0.4` (40% into the line), clipA / clipB, `title` (0) or `end` (after the last line). A shot lasts until the next one starts. Times inside a shot (itemsAt, bigAt, linesAt, numAt, promoAt, barHintAt …) use the same anchors; barHintAt lights the chapter bar's jump-to-any-part hint again (sc00-02, 您也可以根据进度条直接跳到后面的部分). Every word on screen is `中文|English`: Chinese on top, English a little smaller below (Yancy, 2026-10-26: 应该改成中英文，英文比中文稍小一点). Art keys are Codex images in lucas-academy-video-data/middle-income-trap/art/codex (latest -vN), copied by assets.py. `chapters`: the English chapter name for the chapter card, then a short one for the bar.
